title: Yoda
subtitle: Jedi
franchise: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
description: For eight-hundred years Master Yoda trained younglings and Padawans in the ways of the Jedi Order. And his last student, Luke Skywalker, was at his bedside at the end. "Master Yoda, you can't die." Luke told him. But Yoda responded in his sickly voice, "Strong am I with the Force, but not that strong. Twilight is upon me and soon night must fall."
